indexing.npz: zero-based complete prefix plus evaluation stream

capacities.unit: normalized residual system capacity before queues and jobs

rates.unit: expected tasks per node per slot

phase.unit: controlled phase index; not real-trace drift ground truth

feedback_csv_gz.timing: coordinator_ms excludes window fusion and neural worker optimization; training_wall_ms records private worker computation
feedback_csv_gz.logged_training_semantics: active training allocation; may differ from newly admitted training_profile
feedback_csv_gz.structured_cells: JSON strings for arrays, dictionaries and AO trajectories
feedback_csv_gz.empty_value: unavailable; never automatically converted to numeric zero

deployment_json.delay: deployment_slot - launch_slot + 1; may exceed declared active-slot delay due to pause
deployment_json.gain: profile estimate credited on actual completion; not empirical neural reward gain
deployment_json.parameter_hashes: SHA-256 over deployed model parameter bytes before and after deployment

fusion_targets.name: next-window performance-degradation score d3
fusion_targets.availability: target is read only after its window completes
fusion_targets.comparison: intersection of eligible target windows within each seed and scenario
